company.shortDescription: GoSats is a bitcoin rewards app that helps customers to earn bitcoin as cashback while shopping.
company.description: GoSats is a fintech platform that allows users to earn rewards in the form of Bitcoin and gold through everyday spending and online shopping. The platform operates as a cashback and rewards system where purchases made with partner brands generate “Sats,” which can be converted into digital assets. It focuses on providing access to cryptocurrency by enabling users to accumulate Bitcoin through routine transactions rather than direct investment. GoSats includes features such as a rewards card, prepaid wallet, and vouchers to support transactions and reward collection. The company operates within the financial services and blockchain sector, serving users interested in alternative forms of savings.
